title: Jack and the Two Lines on the Map
synopsis: Jack checks his proposed map with Ms. Pam, Captain Ann, and Mr. Fred. He corrects Station Lane's side of Brook Road and distinguishes the road routes, pedestrian bridge, and gravel-yard service lane.
continuity_state: Before: Jack's sketch now includes the full footpath, bridge, brook, green gate, and long farm road. It does not yet locate the garage, parcel shed, Station Lane, and aggregate yard consistently. After: Ms. Pam confirms the longer farm-road branch near her garage, Captain Ann helps Jack fix Station Lane north of Brook Road, and Mr. Fred confirms the gravel-yard service-lane connection. Mr. Lee and Aunt Jo approve a small illustrated board beside the park entrance; adults will build it. No sign is installed yet.
